$schema_note: Acceptance truth. Agents may ONLY flip 'passes' and append 'verified_at'. Editing/removing features, descriptions, or steps is forbidden (constitution #3). Each step must be provable end-to-end by one test run. Detailed criteria live in specs/*/spec.md; this file is the checklist index.

features.name: Identity & Access
steps: Register with email+password → verification email queued (mailpit) → verify via signed payload
Login issues exactly one active token per device_type; re-login same type revokes old token, other types survive; other_login.detected event fired
Google OAuth login creates/links account; non-Google/Meta providers rejected
Passkey registration + assertion logs in without password
2FA TOTP enroll/verify/recovery-codes; 2FA required where policy set; admin can force via org policy hook
Password change requires current password and revokes ALL tokens; email change verifies new + notifies old
Soft-deleted user cannot authenticate (generic error); restore only via admin endpoint
spatie global roles gate /admin/v1; permission names use resource.action

features.name: Teams & Tenancy
steps: Signup auto-creates undeletable personal workspace; current_organization_id set and switchable via endpoint
Org-scoped models are isolated: user A cannot read/modify org B rows even knowing the ID (404)
Plan entitlement max_organizations enforced → 402 SubscriptionRequired when exceeded
Email invite (pending, 7d expiry) + invite link (expiring token) join flows grant pivot role
Builtin org roles owner/admin/member/viewer restrict actions per permission map
Transfer ownership requires 2FA re-check; owner cannot leave before transfer
Org soft-delete confirm-text; restore admin-only

features.name: Billing & Monetization
steps: Plans/plan_prices/entitlements seeded + admin CRUD without deploy
Checkout via StripeGateway creates subscription (card required for trial, not for free)
Own portal: payment methods attach/default/remove; invoice list + signed download URL
Upgrade prorates via gateway preview; downgrade pending flips at period end
Webhook → local mirror synced idempotently (replay-safe via webhook_events)
past_due → grace → downgrade-to-free job transitions observable
Entitlement check org->can/limit returns 402 envelope; FakeGateway passes whole suite with zero Stripe calls

features.name: Notifications
steps: Catalog class per type via make:notification; preferences auto-expose new types
Email queued + Blade markdown layout renders in mailpit
Broadcast delivered to Reverb private user.{id} channel AND persisted for offline list fetch
User can toggle email per type; locked security types cannot be disabled
failed_notifications logged; retry command redelivers

features.name: Admin & Ops
steps: /admin/v1 rejects non-super-admin (403)
Suspend revokes tokens + blocks login; unsuspend restores; reason mandatory
Impersonation: 15-min token with impersonator_id claim, every request audit-logged, ends on expiry/explicit exit
Restore soft-deleted user/org endpoints work
Admin change-org-plan emits domain event + audit + keeps billing mirror consistent; per-org entitlement override works
Audit log append-only (no update/delete routes), filters by subject/causer/date
GET /up reports db/redis/queue health; Horizon reachable for super-admin

features.name: Security & API
steps: Security headers + CORS allowlist + X-Request-Id present on every response
Throttle buckets: login/otp/password-reset return 429 + Retry-After; plan api_rate_limit honored
Integration tokens with abilities enforced (missing ability → 403), shown once, revoke works
2FA-fresh-session required to create token
Logo upload: finfo+re-encode, public read; all other uploads rejected (module 9 deleted) — form field validation test suite green
CI: no mass assignment anywhere; FormRequest on 100% write routes (grep test)
Registrations kill-switch (settings) → 403 register when closed

features.name: Onboarding Events
steps: user.registered fires once on signup and queues welcome email
org.created fires for both personal workspace and user-created orgs
php artisan org:seed-demo {org} is idempotent and demo-provider-extensible

features.name: Settings & Personalization
steps: users.locale + users.timezone validated, defaulted, applied by SetLocale middleware (validation messages in user locale)
spatie typed settings cached; admin CRUD; GET /settings/public exposes whitelist only

features.name: Background Work & Webhooks
steps: OrgScopedJob binds current_organization inside queued code (assert in test)
Outbound webhook: HMAC-SHA256 + timestamp headers verified against shared secret; payload schema documented
Delivery retries with backoff to dead-letter; webhook.failing notification sent; redrive command works
webhook_deliveries log rows contain attempt/status/latency; org CRUD endpoints permissioned

features.name: Dev Platform & CI
steps: harness/init.sh boots cold (fresh clone, no .env) to ready stack idempotently
harness/scripts/check.sh == CI pipeline (pint, phpstan L8, composer audit, pest incl. arch, openapi fresh)
PR touching src/ without specs/ diff fails pr-check
Impl commit without test changes in task scope fails TDD diff-check
Scramble /docs serves full OpenAPI for every route (count assertion test)
golden-org fixture + FakeGateway make module suites run in <90s in CI
